course.title: Humanities NIRBHAY Pro
course.description:
• NIRBHAY Batch – Class 12th Humanities (Boards 2026 + CUET)
  • The Most Fearless, Complete & Score-Boosting Crash Course for Class 12th Boards + CUET 2026 
  • Complete syllabus of History,Political Science, Geography, Economics, English,Hindi, GK, Current Affairs, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Reasoning, Numerical Ability & Quantitative Aptitude for Class 12 Boards + CUET.
  • Boards (Nirbhay) + CUET integrated teaching: Concepts, MCQs & PYQs explained together.
  • PDF notes after every class for Boards + CUET.
  • Regular chapter-wise tests + full syllabus mock tests.
  • Live + Recorded classes of English, Hindi for CUET exam. 
  • CUET General Test included: GK, Current Affairs, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Reasoning, Numerical Ability & Quantitative Aptitude (Live + Recorded Format).
  • CUET Preparation will be in 2 Phases - 

Phase 1: Till Board Exams

Phase 2: After Board Exam

  • Only this batch will continue till your CUET final exam.
